notes: Abu Bakr's first-person narrative («كنت أنا وأبي، فذهبت معه») carries implicit transmission: the chain is read to Aisha because her words are the saying, but the reading turns on that
«مولى أبي بكر» describes Sumayy as client, not a link; the patron is not written as a link here
«فقالت مثل ذلك» (Umm Salama) repeats the saying without its own isnad: not a route
